title: OmniReqDetailsForWA
description: Contains properties specifying to the service how to construct the message for this channel.

template.description: The name of the template to use for this message.

parameters.description: Contains sub-properties with values for variables in the message template. Which sub-properties to include here depends on which template you have selected.

text.description:
The main text of your message.
**Required for:** `text`

header_url.description:
The source URL for a media file or file attachment to embed in the message.
**Required for:** `image`, `video`, `audio`, `file`

file_name.description:
The display name of the file on end-user device. If you do not include a value for this parameter, the service uses a default value of "file".
**Required for:** `file`

latitude.description:
The latitude coordinate of your location (number only).
**Required for:** `location`

longitude.description:
The longitude coordinate of your location (number only).
**Required for:** `location`
